title: Histidine Tautomerism-Mediated Regulation of beta-Hairpin Formation and Primary Nucleation in Amyloidogenic PrP(106-126) A117 V Peptides.
authors: Wang, Lisha; Li, Jing; Altayib, Ahmed; Zhu, Rongrong; Sun, Yue; Shi, Hu; Gao, Lizhen
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟系统研究组氨酸互变异构对朊病毒肽PrP(106-126) A117V的β-发夹形成和初级成核的调控机制，提出两步成核假说，核心贡献在蛋白质构象采样与淀粉样成核的结构计算建模，与本课题高度相关。
abstract: Histidine tautomerism is increasingly recognized as a subtle yet powerful regulator of protein structural dynamics, yet its mechanistic role in amyloid nucleation remains poorly understood. In current study, we investigate how histidine protonation states govern the early stage aggregation and primary nucleation of PrP(106-126) A117 V, a prion-related peptide whose mutation markedly accelerates oligomer formation and cytotoxicity. Using molecular dynamics simulations, we systematically characterized the conformational ensembles of monomers through tetramers across distinct histidine tautomeric states (delta and epsilon). We find that tautomerism exerts minimal influence on beta-sheet propensity in monomers and dimers, but becomes decisive at the trimer and tetramer level: the (deltadeltaepsilon) trimer adopts a beta-hairpin, while the (deltaepsilonepsilonepsilon) tetramer harbors two beta-hairpins that collectively define a nascent nucleation core. Based on these observations, we hypothesize a potential two-step nucleation mechanism within the primary nucleation stage, in which structurally heterogeneous intermediates first accumulate, and one beta-hairpin then serves as a template to recruit and organize a second, culminating in a beta-hairpin-enriched nucleus. Our results establish histidine tautomerism as a molecular switch that gates the transition from disordered oligomers to ordered nuclei, offering a physicochemical framework for understanding primary nucleation in prion and, more broadly, amyloidogenic systems.
abstract_zh: 组氨酸互变异构现象日益被认为是蛋白质结构动力学的微妙而强大的调控因子，但其在淀粉样蛋白成核中的机制作用仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们探讨了组氨酸质子化状态如何调控PrP(106-126) A117 V的早期聚集和初级成核，这是一种朊病毒相关肽，其突变显著加速寡聚体形成和细胞毒性。利用分子动力学模拟，我们系统表征了从单体到四聚体在不同组氨酸互变异构状态（delta和epsilon）下的构象集合。我们发现，互变异构对单体和二聚体中的β-折叠倾向影响甚微，但在三聚体和四聚体水平上变得决定性：(deltadeltaepsilon)三聚体采用β-发夹结构，而(deltaepsilonepsilonepsilon)四聚体包含两个β-发夹，共同定义了一个新生成核核心。基于这些观察，我们假设初级成核阶段存在一个潜在的两步成核机制，其中结构异质的中间体首先积累，随后一个β-发夹作为模板招募并组织第二个β-发夹，最终形成富含β-发夹的核。我们的结果确立了组氨酸互变异构作为分子开关，调控从无序寡聚体向有序核的转变，为理解朊病毒及更广泛的淀粉样蛋白生成系统中的初级成核提供了物理化学框架。
